correctness.rationale: The rank-three failure event is the union over the seven Fano projective lines: with P(T>t)=Σ_L p_L^t−2Σ_P p_P^t for t≥1 (distinct lines meet in one point and each point is on exactly three lines). Summing tail gives 1+Σ_L p_L/(1−p_L)−2Σ_P p_P/(1−p_P). Zero-column replacement weakly improves each sample outcome and is harmless for finding a minimizer. Every no-zero 3×8 generator is encoded by exactly one of 3003 multiplicity compositions (up to column permutation); rank is checked by exclusion from all seven projective lines. Independent exact arithmetic enumerated 2702 full-rank profiles; seven minimizers with multiplicities 2,1,1,1,1,1,1 and value 422/105; runner-up 88/21 in 21 profiles. Independent absorbing-Markov recursion independently gave 422/105 for the minimizing profile. The finite census exhausts this exact finite problem, not arbitrary n or q.
